comment: Recorded from managed by ServiceControlRuntimeTests.NativeLifecycleReconcileVectors; regenerate with OPENBLADE_REGENERATE_NATIVE_PROFILE_VECTORS. profiles is the saved performance the runtime starts from: the plugged-in and battery power profiles and the Game rule's plugged-in override, with Game reported and applied on AC. Each transition row runs in order on that runtime: submitted is whether any device setter was submitted, performance the confirmed preset after it, desired the desired preset and source its source. leaseExpired is ExpireApplicationContextAsync after the 15 s lease; gameReported reports Game again. powerUnchanged, powerToBattery and powerToPluggedIn are HandlePowerSourceChangedAsync with the gate clear. resumeUnchangedAfterDeferral reports Other.exe with the LowPowerGate entered, exits it, and runs HandlePowerSourceChangedAsync on the unchanged source. It models only that part of resume processing: not the rest of ProcessNativeAsync (lighting invalidation and restore, resume validation) or the later convergence. powerToBatteryWithController runs HandlePowerSourceChangedAsync to battery while Razer Synapse's engine is a potential controller; controllerClosedPowerUnchanged clears it and runs HandlePowerSourceChangedAsync on the unchanged source, as a later notice would. userActivatedOnBattery and sameUserReactivated run on a second runtime, initialized on battery with the same profiles and no profile applied: ActivateUserAsync for a user whose saved profiles are those, as its first admitted request runs it, then again for the same user.
